scope: Read-only root-cause review after stopped live readiness run; no new model/API calls, replay, probes, production edits or credential access.

findings.topic: Idle timeout caused the sixth transport attempt to fail
findings.confidence: confirmed local failure classification; remote cause unknown
findings.rootCause: The R6 baseline first generation request for R7-E01 exceeded the configured 120-second inactivity interval. The wrapper terminated the child process and raised MODEL_TIMEOUT. This is an idle timer event, not the 180-second total deadline and not the 90-second observation-delay experiment.

evidence.error: 模型超过设定时间没有返回新数据。已保存的章节会保留，可继续等待更久或从未完成章节续跑。

evidence.mechanism: processCall.activity resets idle timer on stdout/stderr; idle expiry sets policy.timeoutError("idle") and terminates the process.

limitations: The two retained stream events prove thread/turn startup only. They do not establish whether the remote model was still reasoning, the stream stalled, or the service stopped responding.
No turn.completed, turn.failed-with-usage, model response or authoritative billing receipt was captured. No claim is made about provider-side completion or cost.
recommendations: Investigate idle-timeout behavior for silent reasoning using isolated offline process fixtures before another authorized evaluation.
Separate transport activity, progress, cancellation, terminal receipt and usage persistence in diagnostics; preserve the frozen run.
Do not solve this by merely extending an evidence lifetime or weakening business evidence checks. Any future live timeout-policy change requires a new frozen protocol and authorization.

findings.topic: Unknown usage correctly stopped all later dispatch
findings.rootCause: The failed attempted transport had no reported usage. model-receipt retained usageStatus unknown; ledger.settle persisted usage null and EVAL_USAGE_UNKNOWN; runner halted before any seventh call.

evidence.mechanism: settle normalizes usage; missing/invalid usage sets persistent EVAL_USAGE_UNKNOWN. open/reserve refuse halted or unresolved ledgers.

limitations: 95,616 is a known subtotal, not the total cost of all six attempts.
The sixth reservation of 189,210 tokens is admission accounting, not measured usage, an estimate to settle, or proof of an upper bound.
Remaining nominal call/token allowance does not authorize continuation after unknown usage.
recommendations: Keep the sixth usage and aggregate actual total unknown. Preserve both the failed attempt and the known subtotal.
Do not replace unknown with zero/reserved tokens or resume this run. Seek only an exact authoritative receipt if one later becomes available.

findings.topic: No authoritative usage recovery evidence was found within the permitted scope
findings.confidence: confirmed search result; not proof that no provider record exists
findings.rootCause: The sealed attempt contains only startup events. The exact failed thread ID yielded no session filename and no rows in the inspected local CLI log database.

queries: logs WHERE thread_id = exact failed thread ID
logs WHERE ts BETWEEN 1793004180 AND 1793004360 AND instr(feedback_log_body, exact failed thread ID) > 0

evidence.search: filename-only search for the exact failed thread UUID

limitations: No auth files, keys, unrelated session contents, API, login refresh or broad log-body search were accessed.
The CLI invocation uses --ephemeral; this audit does not infer a recoverable rollout or bill from startup metadata.
recommendations: Retain unknown usage. Do not enlarge the search to unrelated conversations or infer usage from elapsed time/input size.

findings.topic: Only the R7 candidate rejected the qualified fixed scheduling draft
findings.confidence: confirmed response and validator chain; independent blind audit supplies business qualification
findings.rootCause: The candidate verifier itself classified the overlap/impossibility conclusion c3 as inference, marked it supported:false despite acknowledging source support, omitted qualification, marked a requirement gap, and returned passed:false. The application then enforced supported===true and the non-fact qualification requirement, emitting QUALIFICATION_MISSING and unmet-requirement issues. R6 instead marked c3 supported:true and supplied a qualification span, so its gate passed. The observed trigger was not an invalid source citation or missing business source.

evidence.mechanism: The validator rejects c.supported!==true and non-fact claims lacking a valid qualification or recognized explicit marker; the candidate c3 has neither supported:true nor qualification.

evidence.instruction: 原文未直接表达、需实质推理得到的结论用inference，须正文标注并引前提；未知/建议须明示。

limitations: The validator carried through an upstream model judgement; this was not a newly fabricated deterministic citation failure.

One fresh paired sample with different model responses cannot identify a causal effect of a particular R7 code change. The inference instruction is shared and qualification module bytes are identical.
Business false-block classification comes from the sealed independent audit; no version/cost information was sent to the blind auditor.
recommendations: Prioritize offline cases distinguishing direct logical entailment from substantive uncertain inference, including overlapping stated time intervals and mutually exclusive attendance conditions.
Check consistency between model supported status, qualification binding and substantive support, without weakening factual/source/uncertainty boundaries.
Retain this result as an observed false block, not proof that R7 code caused a population regression or that all inference marking should be removed.

findings.topic: Candidate fixed-draft verification incurred one additional JSON repair request
findings.rootCause: The first candidate verification produced invalid JSON containing a stray token in claimIds. The existing format-repair path issued one additional request and preserved the rejection judgement.

evidence.parseError: Expected ',' or ']' after array element in JSON at position 1299 (line 1 column 1300)

evidence.mechanism: Invalid JSON is repairable; repairMessages requests valid JSON while preserving facts, conclusions and action intent.

limitations: The extra repair consumed 19,832 known input-plus-output tokens; the first failed-format request also consumed 18,752 tokens.
This is format recovery within the shared ledger, not an uncounted retry or evidence that formatting caused the underlying c3 judgement.
recommendations: Report both charged attempts and attribute the additional request to json_repair.
Use offline malformed-output fixtures to improve observability while preserving business decisions and total-budget accounting.

findings.topic: The targeted dynamic mechanisms were not exercised
findings.rootCause: Global stop occurred in the baseline first E01 generation attempt, before any completed dynamic output or tool request. E01 candidate, both E02 arms and all four revision branches were unattempted.
limitations: Historical file_observation/action_status continuity after 90 seconds, new-file reading, same-task evidence recovery, metadata/H1 revision, requirement retirement/shared-condition retention and dynamic whole-goal acceptance were not tested live.
The long-document E01 source could be present in input, but neither successful rule/exception use nor two explicit sums can be inferred from an unfinished request.
No completed dynamic pair exists, so same-success dynamic efficiency and generated accepted-output hallucination rates are unestimable.
recommendations: State the mechanisms as untested rather than failed or fixed.
Use the offline review to design repairs; any future fresh paired live evaluation requires a separately approved plan and budget. Do not restart, append probes or launch the main evaluation.

limitations: This is a bounded read-only root-cause audit, not a replay or new model evaluation.
Raw logs were not expanded beyond exact failed-thread searches; no authoritative usage recovery was available.
No causal or statistical noninferiority claim follows from this stopped six-call run.
